description: Use this for 'how much would we have caught this month?' style questions: aggregate SHADOW outcomes, near misses, and policy mismatches for the environment-bound organization, so an operator can judge whether to turn enforcement on. It is a read-only operational summary; it neither changes enforcement mode nor executes any commerce action.

days.description: Report window in days. The API default is 30.

limit.description: Maximum report rows to inspect. The API default is 20.

name: commercegate_summarize_shadow_reports
title: Summarize CommerceGate Shadow Reports
